headline: Cape Grinds On as Mooring and Expanse Flare
war_summary: Since the evening wires the pace has shifted toward Mooring County and the Weathered Expanse while Callum's Cape remains the heaviest grinder. Mooring County records six changes in two hours and thirty-five on the day around The Wind Hills and Gravekeeper's Holdfast, holding ten Warden and two Colonial posts amid 2,809 Colonial and 2,269 Warden casualties in two hours with both loss rates accelerating. The Expanse adds six in two hours and twenty-four on the day around Crow's Nest, Spirit Watch and Necropolis, listing six Warden, one Colonial and two ruined posts amid 1,579 Colonial and 2,215 Warden casualties in two hours. Linn Mercy counts three in two hours and thirty on the day around Outwich Ranch, Rotdust and Lathair, listing three Warden, seven Colonial and one ruin. Callum's Cape counts two in two hours but forty-six on the day around Naofa, Scouts Jest and Ire, now split three Warden, three Colonial and one ruin amid 13,878 Colonial and 11,789 Warden losses on the day. Marban Hollow shows three in two hours centered at Checkpoint Bua, Lykos Isle stirs with five in two hours, while Stonecradle, Nevish Line, Godcrofts and Callahan's Passage log none in the last two hours.
